q.g: In this quest you have to find and mark one fuel tanker truck near the power station and one in the northern territory on Interchange with MS2000 Markers. There are 2 trucks available for each objective.

sh.c: Fuel tanker truck locations marked on map
Map marker 1: First power station truck behind the Goshan store
Map marker 3: Second power station truck at the power station
Map marker 2: First northern territory truck west of the highway in the area near the "Path to River" extraction
Map marker 4: Second northern territory truck south of the trailer park
